program_name: KAST Affiliate & Referral Program (official terms effective 2026-05-08)
application_conditions: Two programmes under one set of terms (effective 2026-05-08). Affiliate Program: registration must be "expressly approved by the Company" at its sole discretion; participants must be registered KAST users in good standing with completed identity verification; one Affiliate Account per participant; sub-affiliate structure exists. Referral Program: any eligible KAST user, by sharing a Referral Code, link or QR code (app: Home > Earn); described in the May 2026 blog as "cash referral rewards for normal, non-affiliate users across all KAST tiers".
paid_action: Affiliate Program: Affiliate Clients register through an Affiliate Link/Code and meet criteria KAST specifies; commission amounts "set out on the relevant product pages" (not public). Referral Program: referee completes KYC and reaches card-spend milestones within 45 days of KYC approval — $50 at $600 cumulative eligible spend, a further $50 at the next +$1,000 step (up to $100 per referred user); +$100 if the referee buys Premium, +$1,000 if Private (stackable). Rewards credited to the Cash Rewards balance, 14-day time lock; pro-rata clawback on refunds; no referral cap. Amounts "may vary by country".

commission.model_note: Referral Program (personal, non-affiliate): $50 + $50 per referee on spend milestones ($600, then +$1,000), $100 Premium / $1,000 Private upgrade bonuses — official blog 2026-05-05 (page modified 2026-10-22). Affiliate Program: amounts and rates not published ("set out on the relevant product pages"); no revenue share stated in public text.
commission.tiers_note: amount = first referral milestone ($600 spend). Affiliate-track rates unknown; sub-affiliate commissions follow a structure on the Platform.

notes: 2026-11-17: official Affiliate & Referral Program terms found (effective 2026-05-08) — KAST now runs an approval-based Affiliate Program alongside the personal Referral Program; type changed personal_referral → publisher_affiliate, our_status unchanged (identified). Affiliate rates are not public (shown on product pages after approval). Decision for David: whether to register for the KAST Affiliate Program (requires his own KAST account, KYC and KAST approval); until then his personal referral link stays unused. No outreach made.
rules_note: Terms prohibit: promoting third-party products in connection with the Programs, unsolicited mass communications/spam, redirecting users away from the Platform, misusing links or codes, charging referred users a fee, multiple Affiliate Accounts, self-referral/fake accounts, confusing use of KAST trademarks. Paid ads and brand-keyword bidding are not expressly mentioned. Restricted jurisdictions: residents of jurisdictions where KAST has prohibited or restricted access (no list). Governing law/disputes per KAST Terms of Service (arbitration, class-action waiver). Referral link supplied by David (account holder) on 2026-11-07, not shown anywhere (card not published): https://app.kast.xyz/referral/X64PANZE — it is a personal Referral Program link, not an approved Affiliate link.
legal_entity: KAST Tech and its affiliates (as named in the Affiliate & Referral Program Terms)
validation_conditions: Referral: spend milestones must be met within 45 days of KYC approval; aggregate purchases count; 14-day lock before redeemable; refunded transactions clawed back pro-rata (balance can go negative). Affiliate: tracking-report discrepancies must be raised within ten business days or the Company's records stand. Both: new users only, no self-referral or fake accounts.

payout.threshold: Not stated (affiliate: form, currency and frequency "set by the Company on the Platform")
payout.method: Referral: Cash Rewards balance in the KAST app (14-day lock). Affiliate: on-platform, not detailed.
payout.frequency: Referral: triggered at milestone, redeemable after 14 days. Affiliate: not stated.
payout.holdbacks_note: Clawback on refunds (pro-rata); Company may withhold, adjust or reclaim commissions on suspected abuse and set off against future payments; no commissions owed after termination for breach or fraud.

allowed_countries_note: Not listed; participants may not be connected to a jurisdiction where KAST restricts access; referral amounts "may vary by country".
